inputModel: Bindings, the orchestrator, its native receipt writer and the finality-proof pins are verifier-owned. Receipt blockRef.timestamp is CORE SR2-6 consensus time in unix ms. The verifier implements the verifierProfile signature algorithms (ed25519); ecdsa-secp256k1 (a genuine signature under the orchestrator's ecdsaPublicKeys entry) and sr1-aggregate are registered but not implemented by it, so they are indeterminate here. An identity-bound case's identityBinding is the verifier-owned IBH-1..IBH-5 rerun outcome over its placeholder companions; without one the rerun authority is missing. An amendment or resolved artifact is received as its UTF-8 JSON text (json.dumps, ensure_ascii false) unless amendmentText or artifactText gives the exact received text. resolved.anchorReceipts lists every carrier the resolver found for the reference's locator.
